quest.title: Feeling Like Fish Today!
quest.description: Wouldn't it be great if you could catch some fish for your Saurian buddy...? Ace Angler Paimon, you're up!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes, that's one strong fish. How's it still able to swim so fast, even after such a long struggle...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawrrr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No worries, {NICKNAME}'ll definitely be able to catch it again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This shallow water beach looks great! It's warm, bright, and there are fishing rods set up here. Maybe this would make a good fishing spot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we try fishing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe I'll catch myself another travel guide...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way, Paimon vetoes that idea. Besides, there's only one Paimon, and you already caught her!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's talking about fish-fishing! It's been a while since we last ate fish you caught and cooked yourself... Plus, it's about time you gave {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} a taste of your culinary wizardry!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, it's all for poor old {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, y'know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then why don't you get involved too, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about... you do the fishing this time, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You want P—Paimon... to do the fishing?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #All for poor old {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How... How could you, catching Paimon out with her own words like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, alright then... But be warned, Paimon has no idea what she'll catch, if anything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Plus, before that... Ace Angler Paimon needs a nice, tidy environment to work her magic in. What if the line gets snagged on all that junk floating around in the water?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's tidy up the area a bit first!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, nice and tidy at last... G—Guess it's time for Paimon to get started with the fishing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just you wait and see, Paimon's gonna catch a big one!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Sadly, the surface stays as still as a mirror, without a ripple in sight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Is there something wrong with the water here? The fish don't seem to want to come out, at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So close! Yet... so far. Ugh, why does it feel like this is gonna take forever...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a bit early to be getting Paimon's hopes up!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've got it! You've got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, stop being such a distraction... Jeez!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh!? We've got a bite, we've got a bite! Time to reel it in and see what Paimon's caught!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What the... that's not a fish, it's a bottle! And it's even tied to one of the wooden planks at the fishing spot... Ugh, well, the fact that you always catch strange things too makes Paimon feel a little better, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You seem to be able to catch anything... but fish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you catch weird stuff all the time too! Anyway, seeing as Paimon already caught it, we might as well take a look at what's inside...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it have been these two that left behind that pile of stuff just now? People who are this obsessed with fishing are... pretty scary, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like they're using this bottle to pass messages to one another... We'd better throw it back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaaanyway, Paimon has a funny feeling that it'll definitely be a fish next time!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The rod suddenly drops downwards and starts being violently tugged.\nSeems like something big and heavy deep down below has taken the bait...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A bite, at last! Must be one heckuva fish... Up you come, you big lump!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right, you big lump! Up you come!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: R—Rawr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #Seeing Paimon struggling,\nyou and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} grab hold of her...\nBut the line is being pulled with such unstoppable force...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Finally, with a mighty plop, the fish escapes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sobs* That must have been a huge one, otherwise it would never have gotten away!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, so annoying... Huh? It's still swimming around near the surface! Seriously!?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawrr—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No no no, the sea's too dangerous! And you'll never catch up with it anyway...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If only we could find a way to catch that fish, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: It won't be long, trust me! Just stay cool!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, you're probably right. After all, once the bites start coming, it all happens so fast. Like when you go to pick a Sweet Flower, but it turns out to be a Whopperflower...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All you gotta do is stay focused and wait... and wait...

talks.objective: Bring the fish back to shore

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Tada! What did Paimon tell ya? If anyone could get the better of this slippery customer, it'd be {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of skills, if we just threw in all the bait and let the fish get so full that they turned over and floated up to the surface... that would still count as "fishing," right?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrar... Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, you think so too, don't you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Paimon can tell just from the way your eyes are twinkling! Hehe, let's give it a try next time...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawrrr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait a sec, it's not done yet! We have to wait for {NICKNAME} to finish cooking it first!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Once the fish is finished grilling, everyone sits down and eats their fill.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah... Even as Grilled Fish goes, that was something special. You can really tell that Paimon was the one who caught it, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great job, Paimon! You're in charge of fishing from here on out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, there's no such thing as a free lunch, y'know, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! You'll have to help out too next time — if you want any fish, that is!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, look who's playing dumb now!
